resources.string: You have viewer access. Accept creates a new private prompt in your library root with a fresh identity.
Use an instruction, selected review findings, or both. Tap Improve, then check the diff before accepting.
No current findings selected. Improve will use your instruction alone.
Fix the editor validation errors before improving it.

Improve sends the current template front matter and body, your instruction and selected findings to the provider shown on this screen when you tap Improve. Explicit retries send the current template and instruction, current findings, session transcript and feedback. Fill previews and remembered values are never sent. Private templates cannot be improved. Providers see what you send. No telemetry.
Retry sends a fresh template and current instruction with the session transcript and feedback, using the last sent effort. Selected findings are reused only while their source is unchanged.

Front matter and body compare separately. Wide screens show both versions side by side; narrower screens show one list of - removed and + added lines, numbered current → candidate. ↵ marks LF; ␍↵ marks CRLF.

Review sends the current template front matter and body to the provider shown on this screen when you tap Review. Explicit retries send the current template, session transcript and feedback. Fill previews and remembered values are never sent. Private templates cannot be reviewed. Providers see what you send. No telemetry.
Review the current template against the prompt rubric.
Review complete. Select findings or show a quote in the editor.
These findings refer to an older source. Review again before selecting or highlighting them.
Fix the editor validation errors before reviewing it.
Assistant access is unavailable for this library.
Resolve the editor disk conflict before reviewing it.
Quote does not match the reviewed source; it cannot be highlighted.
Retry sends the current template with the session transcript and your feedback, using the last sent effort.
Describe the reusable prompt you want to write

Write sends your brief to the provider shown on this screen when you tap Write. Explicit retries send the session transcript and feedback. Open templates, Fill previews and remembered values are never sent by Write. Providers see what you send. No telemetry.
Retry keeps the last sent brief and effort and adds your feedback. Tap Write to start a new request from the current brief.
Accept saves this exact template, including the displayed identity.
Removed placeholder: %1$s. Remembered values will no longer be used.
Possible placeholder rename: %1$s → %2$s. Remembered values do not follow a rename.
Enter a brief and tap Write. Changes require Accept.
Check the draft and validation issues. Retry with feedback to revise it.
Check the save preview, then Accept or Reject.
The assistant action did not complete.
Set up an active provider in Assistant settings.
Could not load the assistant services. Check app-data access and retry.
Wait for the editor operation or Save / Discard / Cancel decision to finish.
Resolve the editor disk conflict, then show a new diff.
Your access to save this draft is unavailable.
This template is private. Review and Improve are disabled. Write sends only your brief.
Open a prompt to review or improve it. Write needs only a brief.
The source changed. Show a new diff before accepting. Your edits remain available.
The provider, library or editor session changed. Start a new request.
Authentication failed. Check the profile in Assistant settings.
The model was not found. Check its ID in Assistant settings.
The provider is rate limiting requests. Retry later.
The provider is overloaded. Retry later.
The provider could not complete the request. Retry when ready.
Could not read or save provider capabilities. Check app-data access.
The output was truncated. Retry with a shorter request.
The provider declined the request. Revise it and retry.
The provider returned no output. Retry the request.
The provider stopped unexpectedly. Retry the request.
The provider returned an invalid result. Retry with feedback.
Cancelled. Check the editor for any save that had already started.
The request timed out. Retry when ready.
Could not reach the provider. Check the connection and retry.
Fix the draft validation errors and show a new diff before accepting.
The candidate could not be serialized.
Could not assign a prompt identity. Retry the action.
The candidate is too large or complex to compare.
Show a valid diff before accepting.
The source file was deleted on disk. Resolve the editor conflict before accepting.
Could not save the candidate. Check app-data access, then show a new diff to try again.
Prompt saved, but its assistant provenance could not be saved. Do not retry the save.
Prompt saved. History needs maintenance; do not retry the save.
